_comment: Update manifest read by Platform_iOS UpdateCheckService. Host this file at a stable HTTPS URL (e.g. the raw GitHub URL of this file on the default branch) and build the app with --dart-define=UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL=<that url>. On each iOS release: bump the per-channel ios.version to match pubspec (e.g. 5.0.8+24) and point ios.url at the GitHub release that carries the installable IPA. iOS cannot self-install, so 'url' should be a human-openable release page.

ios.notes: Latest internal AutoTeleprompter iOS build for sideload/TestFlight testing.
